title: Finding our way in nature and the direction of the Qiblah
intro: A compass, an app, a shadow – and signs in nature.

learn.html: There are many ways to find the direction of the Qiblah:

items.label: A phone app that shows the prayer times and the Qiblah
The “Qiblah hour” in the prayer timetable

learn.title: The Qiblah hour
learn.html: The prayer timetable has a time called the “Qiblah hour”. At that time on that day, look at the shadow of an object: the Qiblah is in the direction opposite the shadow.

items: tree tops are fuller on the south side than the north
the rings on a tree stump are narrower on the north side and wider on the south
an anthill is on the south side of a stump, stone or bush
on the north side, tree bark is rougher and covered in moss
